summary: First-party executable plugin contributing separate Volcengine ModelArk, Volcengine Speech, and Volcengine MediaKit Providers, plus a plugin-private video-enhancement model card bound to the MediaKit Provider.
context_hints: The plugin id is clash.volcengine; its Provider ids are volcengine-modelark, volcengine-speech, and volcengine-mediakit
Each Provider has independent accounts; the Host exposes only the selected account's apiKey/baseUrl through context.store
Provider request translation, submission, and polling stay inside this plugin
Seedance uses the ModelArk executor and Bearer credentials; Seed Audio uses the OpenSpeech executor and X-Api-Key credentials; video enhancement uses the MediaKit executor and Bearer credentials

This plugin no longer contributes a generic Generator or action. cards/video-enhance.json is a plugin-private model card (semanticShape video_enhancement) whose only declared consumer is the installed clash.video-enhance / video-enhance / enhance generic Generator; bindings/video-enhance.json binds that card to the volcengine-mediakit Provider's volcengine-mediakit-execute executor

The MediaKit adapter only accepts a Host-resolved provider-url video reference; it never falls back to bytes/data URLs. mediaOutputDestination is exposed as a card parameter and validated by the adapter to be a non-empty vod:// or tos:// URI (ModelParameterSchema has no regex/pattern, so this validation lives in buildMediaKitRequest and is covered by adapter tests, not by card JSON schema)
MediaKit's completed result URL expires, so the Host ingests it as a Project Asset immediately after poll returns completed, exactly like Seedance video output

subdirectories.providers: Independent ModelArk, Volcengine Speech, and MediaKit Provider declarations and authentication forms.
subdirectories.cards: Plugin-private video-enhancement model card (semanticShape video_enhancement, kind video, exactly one video input).
subdirectories.bindings: Model-provider binding wiring the video-enhancement card to the volcengine-mediakit Provider/executor with a provider-url-only asset input.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint plus separate ModelArk, OpenSpeech, and MediaKit provider-executors.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations: cards, providers, modelBindings, and provider-executor functions only (no generators/actions).
key_files.providers/volcengine-modelark.json: ModelArk Provider metadata plus API-key and overrideable Base URL fields.
key_files.providers/volcengine-speech.json: OpenSpeech Provider metadata plus its independent API-key and Base URL fields.
key_files.providers/volcengine-mediakit.json: MediaKit Provider metadata plus its independent Bearer API-key and Base URL fields, distinct from ModelArk.
key_files.cards/video-enhance.json: Plugin-private video-enhancement model card; visibility.consumers pins the installed clash.video-enhance / video-enhance / enhance generic consumer.
key_files.bindings/video-enhance.json: Binds the video-enhancement card to volcengine-mediakit with a provider-url-only assetInputs representation.
key_files.src/modelark.ts: Seedance request translation and asynchronous submit/poll lifecycle.
key_files.src/speech.ts: Seed Audio request translation and synchronous OpenSpeech lifecycle.
key_files.src/mediakit.ts: MediaKit enhance-video request translation (tool_version/scene/enhance_style/resolution|resolution_limit/bitrate_level|bitrate/fps/bit_depth/media_output_destination/client_token) and asynchronous submit/poll lifecycle against POST /api/v1/tools/enhance-video and GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}. Video references must resolve to a Host provider-url; bytes are rejected.
key_files.src/stdio.ts: SDK-assembled standard plugin entrypoint exporting exactly three provider-executors.
